decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that these proposals, because of their position, design and appearance, would be acceptable, having due regard for the site characteristics of this Listed building and historic garden and would not be detrimental to the appearance of the Listed building, its ancillary/curtilage structures, the character and appearance of the wider Chiswick House Conservation Area, Thames Policy and Metropolitan Open Land Areas, pedestrian and highway safety, or neighbours living conditions.  The development is in accordance with the UDP Policies  ENV- B.1.1 (New  Development), ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV-N.1.9  (Metropolitan Open Land Improvements), ENV-N.1.5 (Protection of Metropolitan Open Land), ENVN 1.6 (Metropolitan Open Land Acceptable Uses), IMP.5.2 (Thames Policy Area), ENV-W.1.6 (River related infrastructure and other facilities),  ENV-N.1.16 (Historic  Parks and Gardens), ENV-N.2.7 (Trees and Community Woodlands), ENV-N.2.2 (Sites of Regional/ Local Nature Conservation), ENV-N.2.3A (Species Protection), ENV-N.2.6 (Landscape Features) , ENV-N.1.11 (Protection and Improvement of Local Open Space), ENV-B.31 (Ancient Monuments) and ENV-B.3.2 (Sites of Archaeological Importance), and Supplementary Planning Guidance and relevant sections of the London Plan.

Condition : 2 - The toilet block hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before 27/10/2014 in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of existing temporary toilet facilities, erection of access ramp to toilet and erection of screening fence to south and east of toilets.
